out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including food allergy awareness, hand washing, cooling, cold holding, hot holding, reheating, cook temperatures, toxic chemical use/storage, cleaning frequencies, sanitizer use, test kit use, thermometer calibration and employee health policy, as it relates to their assigned duties.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. CDI EHS educated on food safety topics.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating gyro meat off the grill in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. CDI washed hands

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed manager did not wash hands when arriving to the kitchen and using spoon to mix food product.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI hands washed YAFA GRILL (Inspection Date: 10/26/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI soap provided

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed gyro utensils located at the gyro grill that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI cleaned

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: potato slicer encrusted with food debris
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI cleaned

out_items.name: Proper cooking time and temperatures

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: raw chicken and lamb gyro were on grill for hours then placed back in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. CDI taken out of freezer and entire gyro fully cooked. MUST COOK ENTIRE GYRO IN 4 HOURS OR DISCARD THE REST TO PREVENT BACTERIA GROWTH.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. Observed fried cauliflower and eggplant above 70f after 4 hours of cooling on the table.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI food discarded, EHS explained cooling metrics again, provided handouts.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: all items in cold holding wells 47-57f, rice pudding at yogurt in grab-n-go cooler at 45/49f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI food discarded, ice placed in cold wells, HAVE TECHNICIAN FIX WELLS, MONITOR COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES WITH FOOD THERMOMETER.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Rice pudding
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI date marked for saturday

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: The bleach and quaternary ammonium are not being used in accordance with law or the manufacturer's use directions. Observed PIC pour quat into bleach sanitizer sink which creates a toxic gas
violations.corrective_action: Poisonous and toxic materials shall be used according to law and per the manufacturer's directions to prevent injury and contamination. CDI drained sink. EHS educated again about safe chemical usage

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Cooling food on table with lid on and in deep plastic containers and leaving out over 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI EHS educated on cooling methods again and provided handouts.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed bowls/hotel pans that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI stored inverted

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: cold wells at 45f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Have cold wells maintenanced to maintain the food at 41f

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution. PIC does not know how to use test kit.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. CDI Ehs educated on test kit use.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding shall be reheated to a minimum temperature of 165F for 15 seconds. CDI reheated to over 170f.
